Content.LocalizedString: Hey Appraiser, got a minute?
What's wrong?
Yeah, I'm free.

Content.SourceString: 我要出去采购家族信物，一起吗？
Content.LocalizedString: I'm heading out to pick up some family tokens. Wanna come with?
Sure thing.
What type of token is it?
See you at Eibon then!

Content.SourceString: 来了就知道了。伊波恩见！
Content.LocalizedString: You'll find out when you get there. See you at Eibon!
See you at Eibon then!

Content.SourceString: 来了就知道了。伊波恩见！
Content.LocalizedString: You'll find out when you get there. See you at Eibon!
Appraiser, wanna catch a movie?
A movie?
What movie?

Content.SourceString: 呃，可能是，比较暗色调，比较小众，比较能让人背后凉凉的……
Content.LocalizedString: Uhh, it's probably, you know, kind of dark and moody, pretty niche. It's the type that sends chills down your spine…

Content.SourceString: 原来是恐怖电影啊。叫什么名字？
Content.LocalizedString: Oh, so it is a horror movie. What's it called?

Content.SourceString: 这个嘛……你来了就知道了。
Content.LocalizedString: Well… you'll find out when you get there.
Why so mysterious?

Content.SourceString: 嗯……你来了就知道了。宿舍门口见！
Content.LocalizedString: Hmm… you'll find out when you get here. Meet me at the dorm entrance!

Content.SourceString: 嗯……你来了就知道了。宿舍门口见！
Content.LocalizedString: Hmm… you'll find out when you get here. Meet me at the dorm entrance!
Appraiser, got some time?

Content.SourceString: 找到《尼尼历险记》的文件了吗？
Content.LocalizedString: Did you find the files for "Nini's Adventures"?

Content.SourceString: 还没有……比起这个，我有更重要的事拜托你！
Content.LocalizedString: Not yet… But forget about that, I've got something way more important to ask you!
Is it urgent?
Is it that urgent?
You bet it's urgent!
I'll come find you.
Where?

Content.SourceString: 说不清楚具体在哪，我给你发定位！
Content.LocalizedString: Hard to explain exactly where I am, I'll just send you my location!

Content.SourceString: 说不清楚具体在哪，我给你发定位！
Content.LocalizedString: Hard to explain exactly where I am, I'll just send you my location!

Content.SourceString: 什么情况！鉴定师！有没有危险？速回！
Content.LocalizedString: What's going on?! Appraiser! Are you safe?? Text back ASAP!
[Bagel screenshot]

Content.SourceString: 早雾发我看的，是不是那群卖情报的又在挖墙角了！
Content.LocalizedString: Saw this thanks to Sakiri. Is it those intel peddlers sniffing around again??

Content.SourceString: 哼！每次碰面动不动就开始撬我柯林斯家族的智囊团第一人，他们的无赖作风还真都跟早雾说的一样啊！
Content.LocalizedString: Tch! Every time we cross paths, they're always trying to poach the Coluccis' top strategist. Guess their shamelessness really is just like Sakiri said!

Content.SourceString: 现在又打算挖走我家族的新进优秀干部了？
Content.LocalizedString: And now they've got their eyes on our rising star, huh?

Content.SourceString: 本一代目并不担心那些家伙会动摇到柯林斯的根基！但要是他们靠着一手稍微灵通点的消息，拿什么威胁你的话，要赶紧告诉我！
Content.LocalizedString: I, the Ichi-daime, worried not about a few rats shaking our foundation! But if they're using their "oh-so-accurate intel" to threaten you in any way, you better tell me right now!

Content.SourceString: 我这就准备一下，踢馆去！
Content.LocalizedString: I'm suiting up—time to crash their little den.
(emote: angry)

Content.SourceString: 误会了，我没有被威胁。娜娜莉先别冲动，等我回来和你说这事。
Content.LocalizedString: It's a misunderstanding, I'm not being threatened. Don't do anything rash—let's talk once I'm back.

Content.SourceString: 不用担心，老大！我不会背叛柯林斯家族，具体事宜回来向您汇报。
Content.LocalizedString: Don't worry, boss! I'm loyal to the Coluccis. I'll report back in person with the details.

Content.SourceString: 好，真是令人安心的优秀干部！
Content.LocalizedString: That's what I like to hear—reliable as always, my trusted Capo!
I'll be waiting. Don't keep me waiting too long!

Content.SourceString: 快快快！出发时间到！我已经就位了！
Content.LocalizedString: Hurry up! It's go time! I'm ready to go!
Be right there.

Content.SourceString: 鉴定师，本一代目要进行一个突发意见征询——
Content.LocalizedString: Appraiser, this is your Ichi-daime speaking—I need your thoughts on something, stat!

Content.SourceString: 你觉得「波普」的涂鸦怎么样？
Content.LocalizedString: What's your opinion on Bopp's graffiti?

OptionText.LocalizedString: Seems like it has an artistic eye
Seems like it has artistic integrity

Content.SourceString: 我觉得是一个挺有自己艺术审美的异象。
Content.LocalizedString: I think it's an Anomaly with a pretty strong artistic eye.

Content.SourceString: 我觉得是一个挺有自己艺术坚持的异象。
Content.LocalizedString: I think it's got a real sense of artistic integrity.
I knew you'd get it!

Content.SourceString: 「波普」本来就是涂鸦，而涂鸦是街头艺术，也就是说「波普」一定是一个懂艺术的异象！
Content.LocalizedString: "Bopp" is graffiti—and graffiti is street art, which means Bopp has to be a true art connoisseur!
(emote: thinking)

OptionText.LocalizedString: What's got you asking this all of a sudden?

Content.LocalizedString: What's got you asking this all of a sudden?
Nothing, nothing. Just a passing thought. Good night!
Good night.
Arghhhhhhhhhhh!
crying.jpg
Appraiser…
confused.jpg
What's wrong?

Content.SourceString: 无论是便利店还是商超，甚至是二手店我都找过了……
Content.LocalizedString: I've checked every convenience store, supermarket, even secondhand shops…

Content.SourceString: 「蓬绒绒尾巴护理喷雾」全部都断货了！！！
Content.LocalizedString: The Fluffy Tail Care Spray is sold out EVERYWHERE!!!

Content.SourceString: 究竟是谁买走了所有的「蓬绒绒尾巴护理喷雾」！
Content.LocalizedString: WHO bought up all the Fluffy Tail Care Spray?! I wanna know RIGHT NOW!

Content.SourceString: 是「蓬绒绒尾巴护理喷雾」的狂热粉丝！
Content.LocalizedString: They must be obsessive fans of the Fluffy Tail Care Spray!
Anomaly. This has to be the work of an anomaly.

Content.SourceString: 应该只是暂时的断货吧。
Content.LocalizedString: It's probably just temporarily out of stock.
I see…
adjustingglasses.jpg

Content.SourceString: 哼哼，我闻到了阴谋的味道。
Content.LocalizedString: Hmm hmm, I can smell the stench of conspiracy in the air.
Conspiracy?

Content.SourceString: 「蓬绒绒尾巴护理喷雾」失踪事件的背后一定有什么不可告人的秘密！
Content.LocalizedString: There MUST be some dark secret behind the disappearance of the Fluffy Tail Care Spray!

Content.SourceString: 这一切的真相就由柯林斯家族来发现吧！
Content.LocalizedString: Leave it to the Colucci family to uncover the truth behind all this!
troubled.jpg

Content.SourceString: 最近收服小弟的时候，总觉得怪怪的。
Content.LocalizedString: Something feels off whenever I recruit new underlings lately.

Content.SourceString: 眼睛没有问题，爪子没有问题，毛发也用了「蓬绒绒尾巴护理喷雾」定期护理，还是有很奇怪的感觉。
Content.LocalizedString: Eyes r fine, claws r fine, fur's getting regular treatment with the Fluffy Tail Care Spray, but something still feels REALLY off.

Content.SourceString: 就好像握住了饮料瓶的脖子一样……
Content.LocalizedString: It's like I'm in the neck of a bottle…
Are you trying to say… bottleneck?
Yes! That's the word! That's my Capo!
Appraiser, got any ideas to help me out?

Content.SourceString: 不如去问问神奇的阿德勒先生吧？
Content.LocalizedString: Why not ask the amazing Adler about it?

Content.SourceString: 换个思路，不如去问问塔吉多吧。
Content.LocalizedString: Let's try a different approach. Why not ask Taygedo about it?
I'll help you.

Content.SourceString: 很有道理，大叔一定有办法！
Content.LocalizedString: Makes total sense! Old man's definitely got a solution!
confused.jpg
flexing.jpg
Thanks, Appraiser!
Oh! I get it now!

Content.SourceString: 哦哦！是和鉴定师交手的机会吗！
Content.LocalizedString: Ohhhh! Is this my chance to throw down with u?!
thanks.jpg

Content.SourceString: 鉴定师的意思是找塔吉多当陪练对吧？
Content.LocalizedString: So u mean I should get Taygedo as my training partner, right?
I'm ready to rock!
Just try it a few times and you'll see!
evilgrin.jpg

Content.SourceString: 好无聊啊，最近都没什么委托上门。
Content.LocalizedString: Sooo bored rn! Barely any commissions coming in lately

Content.SourceString: 这样不好吗？每天都是休息日。
Content.LocalizedString: Isn't that nice though? Every day's a day off.
Yeah, it is getting a bit boring.
sigh.jpg

Content.SourceString: 啊啊啊啊啊啊再躺下去感觉尾巴都要断了！
Content.LocalizedString: UGHHHHH if I lie around any longer my tail's gonna fall off for real!!

Content.SourceString: 而且我欠易聘屋的钱怎么办？
Content.LocalizedString: And what about the money I owe EZ-Hire?
(Nanally recalled a message)
I saw that, you know.
XD.jpg

Content.SourceString: 鉴定师，既然我们都没什么事做，不如一起去赚外快吧！
Content.LocalizedString: Appraiser! Since we're both just sitting around doing nothing, wanna go make some cash on the side together?

OptionText.LocalizedString: That's an abrupt change of subject…

Content.LocalizedString: I'll have to decline.

Content.SourceString: 转话题的方式也太生硬了吧……
Content.LocalizedString: That's quite the abrupt change of subject…
What kind of side?

Content.SourceString: 就在伊波恩附近的墙上贴的广告。
Content.LocalizedString: There's an ad posted on the wall right next to Eibon.
<Blue>advertisement.jpg</>

Content.SourceString: 你看这上面写的「重金酬谢」，真的不心动吗？
Content.LocalizedString: Look at this "GENEROUS REWARD" part! U sure ur not even a little tempted?

Content.SourceString: 看上去就非常的不靠谱……
Content.LocalizedString: It looks incredibly fishy…

Content.SourceString: 有你有我，我们强强联手，还有什么能拦住我们！
Content.LocalizedString: With you and me together, we're an unstoppable team! Nothing can stand in our way!

Content.SourceString: 如果被浔小姐知道的话……
Content.LocalizedString: If Hotori found out about this…
(Nanally is offline)

Content.SourceString: <Blue>「惊！桥间地近日出现不明黑影，勘察现场后却一无所获，这背后究竟隐藏着什么？详情请戳……」</>
Content.LocalizedString: <Blue>"SHOCKING! Mysterious black shadow spotted in Bridge Crossings recently, but investigation turns up NOTHING! What secrets lurk behind this phenomenon? Click for details…"</>
Appraiser check this out!

Content.SourceString: 看不清脸的黑影，漂浮在空中，触碰不到……该不会是……
Content.LocalizedString: A shadowy figure with no visible face, floating in mid-air, untouchable… This couldn't be… a GHOST?!
A ghost!
An anomaly!
Performance art!

Content.SourceString: 随便是什么啦，敢靠近我，先尝尝我拳头的滋味。
Content.LocalizedString: Whatever it is, try coming near me and u can taste my fist first!

Content.SourceString: 对了鉴定师，我今晚要在宿舍里制定新一季的家族发展计划，你和他们都说一声。
Content.LocalizedString: Oh btw Appraiser, I'm drafting our family's new seasonal development strategy in my dorm tonight, go tell everyone else about it.
Nanally… are you actually afraid of ghosts?!
Ghosts? Me, afraid of those? Pfft.
flexing.jpg

Content.SourceString: 不过是没有脚漂浮在半空中的黑影而已，就是在桥间地的街道上飘来飘去。
Content.LocalizedString: It's just a floating black shadow with no feet hovering in mid-air, drifting back and forth across the streets of Bridge Crossings.

Content.SourceString: 晚上飘到一扇窗子面前，轻轻敲了敲，没人应答就再敲敲……
Content.LocalizedString: At night it floats up to someone's window and taps gently, then if nobody answers it just keeps knocking…
Knock knock.
And then?
It's just a rumor.

Content.SourceString: 帮派兴建大计怎么只能有我一个人决定呢，我觉得柯林斯家族成员应该全体出席。
Content.LocalizedString: Why should I be the only one making decisions about our gang? I think all Colucci family members should be present for this.
Right, Appraiser?
I second that.
You're not scared?
Bad morning.
pleading.jpg

Content.SourceString: 你们最近神神秘秘的在干嘛呢？
Content.LocalizedString: What have you all been up to lately with all this secrecy?
Perfect timing!
Wait, lemme ask Sakiri first.
confused.jpg
(Five minutes later)

Content.SourceString: 早雾说可以告诉鉴定师你，嘿嘿。
Content.LocalizedString: Sakiri says I can tell u about it, hehe!

Content.SourceString: 大叔最近好忙啊，感觉连睡觉的时间都不够了。
Content.LocalizedString: Old man's been super busy lately, feels like u barely have time to sleep anymore.

Content.SourceString: 所以我们准备给他点惊喜或者分担些事情。
Content.LocalizedString: So we're planning to surprise him or help take some things off his plate.

Content.SourceString: 埃德嘉帮他整理最近的委托记录，还找到了很多有用的资料。
Content.LocalizedString: Edgar's been helping him organize recent commission records and even found a bunch of useful info.

Content.SourceString: 塔吉多说他的新发明可以帮大叔打扫家务，不过那机器看上去就不太靠谱。
Content.LocalizedString: Taygedo says his new invention can help him with housework, but that machine looks real sketchy.

Content.SourceString: 早雾什么都没说，但根据我对她的了解，肯定已经准备好了！
Content.LocalizedString: Sakiri didn't say anything, but knowing her, she's definitely got something prepared already!
Have you figured out what you want to do?

Content.SourceString: 就是想法太多了……比如多找几个小弟帮忙，这样就能做很多事情；或者平常总是大叔下厨，要不要换我们来一次；或者最近白鲸书店有好多新的漫画书，大叔不是很爱看书吗？
Content.LocalizedString: I just have too many ideas… Like getting underlings to help out with whatever, or maybe we should cook for him instead of him always cooking for us, or there's a bunch of new manga at Moby-Dick Bookstore lately, doesn't he love reading?

Content.SourceString: 不知道选什么了，鉴定师……
Content.LocalizedString: Idk what to choose…
Let's go find some underlings to join the gang.

Content.SourceString: 那就让我们为阿德勒先生准备一顿大餐吧。
Content.LocalizedString: Then let's prepare a feast for Adler.
Buy books
I'll go round up some people right away!
yaaaay.jpg
We're on the same wavelength!

Content.SourceString: 娜娜莉你的存款还够吗？
Content.LocalizedString: Nanally, do you have enough savings for this?

Content.SourceString: 我想吃烤的脆脆的青花鱼，还有裹满酱汁的小羊排！还有还有！
Content.LocalizedString: I want crispy grilled mackerel! Sauced lamb chops! And more!
yaaaay.jpg
Savings? What savings?
All of them sound good!

Content.SourceString: 《周刊Fantasy》到货了，还有《特工Z世代》的单行本，听说有部新漫画也不错。
Content.LocalizedString: The new "Weekly Fantasy" just dropped! Also got the "Gen Z" volumes, and heard there's a cool new manga series too.

Content.SourceString: 等等，鉴定师你知道怎么区分糖和盐吗？
Content.LocalizedString: Wait, do u know how to tell sugar from salt?

Content.SourceString: 这些听起来不像是阿德勒先生爱看的书。
Content.LocalizedString: Those don't sound like books Adler would enjoy.

Content.SourceString: 为了柯林斯的大业，还不够吗？
Content.LocalizedString: Isn't it worth it for the Colucci Family's grand mission?

Content.SourceString: 难道每次放调料前都要尝一下？
Content.LocalizedString: Do we have to taste every seasoning before using it?
Oh.
smile.jpg

Content.SourceString: 那大叔喜欢看什么样的书呢？
Content.LocalizedString: So what kinda books does the old man like anyway?
"Thus Spoke Guan"?

Content.SourceString: 不愧是大叔，只是看到书名我就开始犯困了。
Content.LocalizedString: Typical old man stuff. Just reading the title is making me sleepy already.
Appraiser?
Hello.
What's wrong?
pleasedtomeetyou.jpg

Content.SourceString: 你有没有兴趣加入一个伟大的家族？
Content.LocalizedString: Wanna join a great family?

Content.SourceString: 虽然还是在起步阶段，但是我有信心，它绝对会成为整个海特洛市最厉害的家族！
Content.LocalizedString: We're just getting started, but I'm telling u, we're gonna be the most powerful family in all of Hethereau!

Content.SourceString: 现在加入你就是我们柯林斯家族的骨干，怎么样？
Content.LocalizedString: Join now and ur basically gonna be a Capo in the Coluccis! Whaddya say?
Sounds pretty good to me.
Uh… I'm not really interested in that right now.
T
U got a good eye, u got a good eye!
Is the compensation package not good enough?
Not a scam message! It's really me!

Content.SourceString: 家族兴建大计又成功了一步！柯林斯，一击即中——
Content.LocalizedString: Another successful step in our family expansion plan! The Coluccis, ready to strike…

Content.SourceString: 要不我给你讲讲柯林斯家族的光荣事迹吧。
Content.LocalizedString: How bout I tell u about the glorious history of the Coluccis?
Prove it.

Content.SourceString: 我突然想起来还有点急事。
Content.LocalizedString: I just remembered I have some urgent business to take care of.
Hang tight.
Let's go again! Ready to strike…

Content.SourceString: 煤气忘记关了，回聊，娜娜莉。
Content.LocalizedString: I'll need to return some video tapes. Let's chat later, Nanally.
<Blue>"Picture"</>
Nullify the evil!

Content.SourceString: 欸？？？？我还没说到精彩的地方呢！
Content.LocalizedString: Whaaaaaaaaaa I haven't even gotten to the good part yet!

Content.SourceString: 这下相信了吧，我，柯林斯家族一代目，娜娜莉本人！如假包换。
Content.LocalizedString: Now u believe me? It's me, Nanally, the Ichi-daime of the Coluccis! The real deal, no knockoffs here!

Content.SourceString: 柯林斯的未来就在我们身上了！骨干！
Content.LocalizedString: The future of the Coluccis rests on our shoulders! Capo!
Yeah, I believe you now.
I don't believe it

Content.SourceString: 不过能加入柯林斯家族这种好事，确实很像天上掉馅饼。
Content.LocalizedString: But joining the Coluccis? That's like hitting the jackpot outta nowhere! Too good to be true, right?

Content.SourceString: 谁敢假扮我娜娜莉！感觉拳头已经痒了！
Content.LocalizedString: Who dares impersonate me, Nanally?! My knuckles are already itching for action!

Content.SourceString: 你的感觉很灵敏嘛，不愧是鉴定师。
Content.LocalizedString: U got sharp instincts! Exactly what I'd expect from an Appraiser

Content.SourceString: 你要怎么才相信我是真的？
Content.LocalizedString: What's it gonna take for u to believe I'm the real deal?
…Thanks for the compliment.
How about sending me 5,000 Fons first to prove you're legit?

Content.SourceString: 换个其他方式？说点只有伊波恩的人才知道的事情。
Content.LocalizedString: Maybe try something else? Tell me something only someone from Eibon would know.

Content.SourceString: 不客气不客气，以后就是一家人了嘛！
Content.LocalizedString: No worries, no worries! We're gonna be family soon anyway!

Content.SourceString: 额……那天塔吉多展示新发明失败，是因为被我和早雾拆过一次，再装回去后发现多了一个零件。
Content.LocalizedString: Ummm… that day when Taygedo's new invention failed? That happened cuz me and Sakiri took it apart once, and when we put it back together we found an extra component after.

Content.SourceString: 等等，那你怎么证明你是真的鉴定师？
Content.LocalizedString: Wait a sec… How u gonna prove ur actually an Appraiser?

Content.SourceString: 当时埃德嘉也在，他们都能替我作证。这下能证明我就是娜娜莉了吧？
Content.LocalizedString: Edgar was there too, they can both vouch for me. Now u believe I'm the real Nanally, right?
XD.jpg
XD.jpg

Content.SourceString: 等等，鉴定师你不会说出去吧？？
Content.LocalizedString: Wait, ur not gonna tell anyone about this, right??
Ur seriously not gonna tell anyone, right?!?!?!
Capo, u free right now?
Appraiser, u free right now?
Yeah, I'm free.
Maybe?
The gas is still on…
Just a tiiiiiny bit of Time.
pleading.jpg
Alright.

Content.SourceString: 我昨晚深刻反思了一下，作为柯林斯一代目，我实在是太失职了。
Content.LocalizedString: I did some serious self-reflection last night, and as the Ichi-daime of the Coluccis, I've been totally slacking on my duties

Content.SourceString: 所以为了家族能更好的发展，我决定来问问你。
Content.LocalizedString: So for the betterment of our Family's future, I've decided to consult with u.

Content.SourceString: 你觉得柯林斯距离成为海特洛第一家族还差点什么？
Content.LocalizedString: What do u think the Coluccis need to become the #1 family in Hethereau?

Content.SourceString: 一切恐惧都源自火力不足。
Content.LocalizedString: Fear stems from lack of firepower.

Content.SourceString: 应该需要一个很聪明的二把手。
Content.LocalizedString: Probably need a clever right-hand man.

Content.SourceString: 什么都不缺，柯林斯家族已经很强大了。
Content.LocalizedString: Nothing. The Coluccis are already powerful enough.

Content.SourceString: 看来是人手问题，还需要更多的小弟才行。
Content.LocalizedString: Gotta recruit more underlings if we wanna make it big.

Content.SourceString: 哦哦，原来是缺少军师吗？
Content.LocalizedString: Ohhhh, so we need a consigliere?
thumbsup.jpg
(Nanally is offline)

Content.SourceString: 埃德嘉倒是可以，但是他总是不太积极的样子，不行不行……谁合适呢？
Content.LocalizedString: Edgar could work, but he's always looking so unmotivated, no no no… who would be perfect for this?

Content.SourceString: 海特洛市最大的帮派，独当一面的冷酷老大，不需要说话，一挥手就有无数的小弟上前……
Content.LocalizedString: The biggest gang in Hethereau, with me as the cold-blooded boss who stands alone… No need to speak, just one wave of my hand and countless underlings rush forward…
confused.jpg
It's gotta be you, Appraiser!

Content.SourceString: 我已经可以想象到那个场景了哈哈哈哈哈哈哈哈哈哈哈哈哈哈哈哈哈!
Content.LocalizedString: I can totally picture that scene already hahahahahahahahahaha!
(You are now Hidden)
confused.jpg

Content.SourceString: 最近好像不怎么看到娜娜莉你出门。
Content.LocalizedString: I haven't seen you going out much lately, Nanally.
Are you feeling unwell?
No way, I'm healthy as a horse!
flexing.jpg
confused.jpg

Content.SourceString: 好吧好吧……你不会说出去吧？
Content.LocalizedString: Fine fine… ur not gonna tell anyone, right?
I won't.
Absolutely not.

Content.SourceString: 月光当铺不是能实现人的心愿嘛……
Content.LocalizedString: Isn't Pawn Moonlight supposed to grant wishes and stuff…

Content.SourceString: 要是我能跟达芙蒂尔师父一样厉害，那就不愁家族的发展了吧。
Content.LocalizedString: If I could be as badass as Master Daffodill, I wouldn't have to worry about my family's growth at all.
Nanally…

Content.SourceString: 所以我这几天通宵看完了所有借来的漫画书，终于！
Content.LocalizedString: So I stayed up all night these past few days to finish ALL the manga I borrowed, and FINALLY!

Content.SourceString: 这本《有界怪谈》里面提到一个「阳光商店」，只要在中午十二点真诚的许愿就可以实现愿望了。
Content.LocalizedString: This "Tales of All" book mentions a "Shop Sunlight" where ur wishes come true if u make them sincerely at exactly 12 noon!

Content.SourceString: 所以这几天不出门其实都是在看漫画啊……
Content.LocalizedString: So that's why you haven't been going out… you've just been reading manga all this time…
Any of your attempts actually work?

Content.SourceString: 听上去很像什么盗版漫画书……
Content.LocalizedString: Sounds like some bootleg manga to me…
Umm…
What about this one?

Content.SourceString: 尝试过几次啦……就是许愿的时候闭着眼，好几次都不当心睡过去了……
Content.LocalizedString: I've tried a few times… but I closed my eyes when making wishes and ended up accidentally falling asleep several times…

Content.SourceString: 《被神秘歧骸咬过之后意外获得了超能力》！
Content.LocalizedString: "Getting Superpowers After Being Bitten by a Mysterious Oddity"!
XD.jpg

Content.SourceString: 拥有蒲公英那样的空间异象能力……好酷！
Content.LocalizedString: Having Space Anomaly powers like Dandelion… so cool!
What if Taygedo bit me…

Content.SourceString: 就会变成笨笨的海獭电视机。
Content.LocalizedString: You'd turn into a silly Otter TV.
<Red>Taygedo, Taygedo!</>
Let's not do that then.

Content.SourceString: 塔吉多看起来好难过啊……
Content.LocalizedString: Taygedo looks so sad…

Content.SourceString: 有吗？今天早上塔吉多还让阿德勒先生给它多加了两个海胆。
Content.LocalizedString: Really? Just this morning, Taygedo got Adler to give it two extra sea urchins.

Content.SourceString: 看起来食欲很好的样子。
Content.LocalizedString: Seems to have a healthy appetite.

Content.SourceString: 不不不，这只是表面，让看透一切的娜娜莉侦探来告诉你吧。
Content.LocalizedString: No no no, that's just what it looks like on the surface! Let Detective Nanally who sees through everything tell u what's really going on
proud.jpg
confused.jpg
starstruck.jpg
serious.jpg

Content.SourceString: 可怜的塔吉多，失恋却无法表达，只能通过吃东西来缓解内心的痛苦。
Content.LocalizedString: Poor Taygedo can't express its heartbreak, so it's just eating away the pain.
This can't go on anymore!

Content.SourceString: 作为柯林斯一代目，这种时候应该好好关心小弟才行！
Content.LocalizedString: As the Ichi-daime of the Coluccis, I gotta take care of my underlings in times like these!

Content.SourceString: 可是在公园打扫的时候，你还说……
Content.LocalizedString: But when we were cleaning up at the park, you said…
(Nanally is offline)
(Five minutes later)
Stupid Taygedo!
confused.jpg
What's going on now?

Content.SourceString: 我拿出了珍藏的漫画书还有零食，结果那家伙居然得了便宜还卖乖，还要我当它的小弟？！！
Content.LocalizedString: I pulled out my precious manga collection and snacks for that thing, and not only does it take advantage of my kindness, it has the nerve to demand I become its underling?!
And then?

Content.SourceString: 当然狠狠教训了它一顿，哼。
Content.LocalizedString: Of course I taught that thing a lesson it won't forget, hmph.

Content.SourceString: 这一周伊波恩里都不会出现海胆了！半个都不行！
Content.LocalizedString: No sea urchins allowed in Eibon for a whole week! Not even half of one!
